name: job-sheet
title: Workshop job sheet
for_each: select id, number from work_orders where status in ('open','in_progress','on_hold') order by number

sections.title: Job
sections.sql: select w.number, v.name as vehicle, v.plate, v.make || ' ' || v.model as model, w.odometer as "odometer at booking", coalesce(vd.name, 'in house') as workshop, w.due_on as "needed by" from work_orders w join vehicles v on v.id = w.vehicle_id left join vendors vd on vd.id = w.vendor_id where w.id = $1

sections.title: Work requested
sections.sql: select task, notes from work_order_lines where work_order_id = $1 order by created_at

sections.title: Reported faults
sections.sql: select title as fault, priority, reported_on as reported, reported_by as "reported by" from issues where work_order_id = $1

sections.title: Sign-off
sections.note: Technician name, odometer out, parts used and invoice number. A completed job sheet records the work done; it does not certify the vehicle as roadworthy.
sections.sql: select '' as technician, '' as "odometer out", '' as "invoice", '' as "date" where $1::text is not null

name: vehicle-history
title: Vehicle service history
for_each: select id, name from vehicles where status <> 'sold' order by name

sections.title: Vehicle
sections.sql: select name, plate, vin, year, make, model, odometer, meter_read_on as "odometer read" from vehicles where id = $1

sections.title: Completed work
sections.sql: select w.number, w.completed_on as completed, w.odometer, coalesce(vd.name, 'in house') as workshop, string_agg(l.task, '; ') as work, w.currency, round((select total_cents from v_work_orders x where x.id = w.id)/100.0, 2) as total from work_orders w left join vendors vd on vd.id = w.vendor_id left join work_order_lines l on l.work_order_id = w.id where w.vehicle_id = $1 and w.status = 'completed' group by w.id, vd.name order by w.completed_on desc

sections.title: Renewals on record
sections.sql: select upper(kind) as renewal, due_on as "due on", due_km as "due km", done_on as renewed, reference from renewals where vehicle_id = $1 order by coalesce(due_on, created_at::date) desc

name: depot-cost-statement
title: Depot running cost statement, last 12 months
for_each: select depot as id, depot as name from vehicles where status <> 'sold' group by depot order by depot

sections.title: Vehicles
sections.sql: select vehicle, currency, round(fuel_cents/100.0,2) as fuel, round(workshop_cents/100.0,2) as workshop, round(other_cents/100.0,2) as other, round(total_cents/100.0,2) as total, km, cents_per_km as "cents per km" from v_costs where depot = $1 order by total_cents desc

sections.title: Totals
sections.sql: select currency, round(sum(total_cents)/100.0,2) as total, sum(km) as km from v_costs where depot = $1 group by currency
